results.title: The “black box” of digital finance: An umbrella review ...
results.content: # The “black box” of digital finance: An umbrella review of the challenges and drawbacks in advancing financial inclusion. Identifies five major barriers to financial inclusion through digital finance. Introduces the concept of the "black box" in digital financial inclusion initiatives. In recent years, scholars have highlighted the pivotal role of digital finance in promoting financial inclusion among underserved populations, alleviating urban poverty, supporting individuals and households, and fostering green economies. However, despite these benefits, digital finance also presents challenges and limitations, including the risk of triggering financial crises. The analysis identifies five key barriers to financial inclusion via digital finance: accessibility, technological and ethical, and economic and structural challenges, as well as regulatory and policy barriers, and social and behavioral factors. This review introduces the concept of a digital finance “black box”, highlighting the uncertainty surrounding the outputs of financial inclusion initiatives resulting from policy interventions. ## Graphical Abstract. ## Data availability.
